---
name: Feature request
about: Something five46 can't do yet that you think it should
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What's missing**
What you're trying to do, and where five46 currently falls short of it —
a specific goal/flow it couldn't express or complete is more useful here
than a general description.

**What you'd expect instead**
What the right behavior would look like, from your side.

**Have you hit this against a real site/API?**
If so, which one (or what kind of interaction pattern) — real, reproducible
examples are what usually turn into an [eval case](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-an-eval-case)
and an actual fix, much faster than a general description.
